content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘CLIENT’ means Johnathan V. Swift, and ‘SERVICE PROVIDER’ means Tech Innovators LLC.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_SCOPE_OF_SERVICES
content_blocks.text: The SERVICE PROVIDER shall provide software development services as outlined in Exhibit A attached hereto and made a part hereof.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._PAYMENT_TERMS
content_blocks.text: The CLIENT shall pay the SERVICE PROVIDER $50,000 upon signing this agreement and an additional $10,000 upon completion of the project.
